claims.claim: Pentair remains positioned across residential, commercial and industrial water systems and announced the planned Taco Group acquisition to broaden hydronic and water-based solutions.
Q2 sales were $933M, down 17%, with the decline driven by roughly $170M of Pool channel inventory destocking.

risks.risk: Pool channel inventory correction and housing/rate sensitivity can obscure underlying end demand.

contradictions.contradiction: Strategic water-platform expansion is occurring during a sharp reported-sales contraction driven by channel reset.

unknowns.unknown: Magnitude and timing of normalized Pool sell-through after destocking remain uncertain.

claims.claim: Q2 adjusted return on sales was 25.4%; operating cash flow was $572M and free cash flow $553M despite the sales decline.
Management reaffirmed adjusted EPS guidance of $4.60-$4.80 while expecting full-year reported sales down roughly 4%-7% as channel inventory is right-sized for 2027.

risks.risk: Guidance depends on successful inventory normalization and excludes the anticipated Taco acquisition.

unknowns.unknown: 2027 rebound magnitude after channel reset is prospective.
